relationships.evidence_quote: These results collectively demonstrate that DAP protects against NLRP3 inflammasome stimulation in NPCs.

relationships.subject: Daphnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: DAP stimulates mitophagy, which improves the elimination of damaged mitochondria and reduces the buildup of mitochondrial ROS in TBHP-induced NPCs

relationships.subject: Daphnetin
relationships.evidence_quote: DAP significantly increased Nrf2 nuclear translocation while reducing Keap1 expression in the whole cells

relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that PINK1 is downstream of Nrf2 and that DAP might regulate PINK1-mediated mitophagy through Nrf2

relationships.subject: mitophagy
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that DAP suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome assembly in NPCs through a mitophagy-dependent mechanism.

key_findings: Daphnetin attenuates TBHP-induced ECM degradation, ROS and NLRP3/caspase-1/IL-1β activation in nucleus pulposus cells
Effect is mediated by Nrf2/PINK1-dependent mitophagy, and protects against disc degeneration in a rat puncture model
